Author: mirage
Name: Veilay
Punchline: Hide models locally, clear the HUD, and lock the camera for cleaner overlays.
Description: Hides player, pet, NPC, and enemy models without despawning them, so position-based overlays like Splatoon still track. Optionally replace models with dummies, hide nameplates with Enable Veilay, hide selected HUD Layout elements, mute battle effects, target lines, fly text, and pop-up text during duty replay, and lock the camera. Models, HUD, and camera each apply independently; character-config changes stay replay-only.
